basis_statement: Problem codes are explicit northbound recovery contracts rather than ad hoc HTTP strings so browser, native, automation, and future endpoints can rebase or stop from one typed envelope.

problem_rows.title: Command envelope is invalid
problem_rows.detail_template: The northbound command envelope did not match the required command-family shape, target scope, or truth-boundary contract.
notes: Use when the envelope shape, precondition profile, or family mapping is malformed before any durable work is accepted.

problem_rows.title: Command target does not match the declared scope
problem_rows.detail_template: The command targeted the wrong manifest, work-item, or governance reference for its declared command family.
notes: Use when nullable and required target references are inconsistent with the command family.

problem_rows.title: Governance simulation basis is required
problem_rows.detail_template: This governance command must carry the reviewed policy snapshot, dependency topology, simulation basis, and mutation basis contract before it can be admitted.
notes: Use when a simulation-backed governance family omitted one of the reviewed basis inputs.

problem_rows.title: Preview-only governance simulation cannot be committed
problem_rows.detail_template: The reviewed governance mutation basis still carries PREVIEW_ONLY authority and cannot become a durable write.
notes: Use when the backend would otherwise let preview styling outrun legal governance approval posture.

problem_rows.title: The current view is stale
problem_rows.detail_template: The action was formed from stale command-side view state and must be rebased against the latest authoritative guard value before retry.
notes: Use for true stale-view conflicts such as decision-bundle, approval-pack, request-state, policy-snapshot, or topology drift.

problem_rows.title: Route continuity changed and the action must be rebased
problem_rows.detail_template: The route-stability token, render frame, or live route continuity changed, so the action must move onto the latest grouped marker generation before retry.
notes: Use for shell token, frame epoch, or other route-continuity drifts where the client must mount the current route generation first.

problem_rows.title: The idempotency key was reused for a different command meaning
problem_rows.detail_template: The supplied idempotency key already belongs to a different payload or namespace tuple, so the boundary refused to guess user intent.
notes: Use when the same client key is reused with a different payload body or semantic target.

problem_rows.title: Policy rejected the command
problem_rows.detail_template: The command reached the northbound boundary but failed an explicit policy gate and was not accepted for execution.
notes: Use for typed policy denials that are not stale-view or shape failures.
